Needs a refresh with main before merge. The code review found no blockers.

This is the secondary safety-floor review of the head. It checks the code against the claims of the safety-tier review of this head. The runner path was skipped by instruction; all commands ran locally, in a worktree, on the PR head without a merge.

**Verdict on the claims.** Each claim is true of the code:
- Chord sampling interpolates the radius with the swept angle. See `radius = ra + (rb - ra) * j/n` in `arc_chords` (`crates/cl/src/cl/moves.rs:319`). Playback does the same (`crates/sim/src/sim.rs:444`). Equal-radius arcs are unchanged, so the defaults stay bit-for-bit.
- The chord-error bound includes the radius change (`crates/cl/src/cl/moves.rs:293-299`). The bound `hypot(r, 2|dr/dtheta|)` is correct for a radius linear in the angle.
- The holder check accepts the ramp: `kerf_of` no longer needs equal end radii (`crates/app/src/operation/turning_rapids.rs:378-381`). Contact detection is unchanged, and the new test proves the holder still hits the part on the ramp moves.
- The manifest list in `assets/posts/AGENTS.md:22` keeps `endUnits` and `continuousThreading`, with the count "the last ten". The remerge-diff of `5f564c470` shows that file as the only hand resolution. This is correct.

**Other checks.**
- The engine refuses dips for a script without `continuousThreading`, and the app turns post warnings into a block (`crates/app/src/posting.rs:787`). G76 refuses dips by name. The Fanuc script refuses a dip that does not continue a chain, is steeper than 45 degrees, or is deeper than the plunge.
- The chain state is sound: a rapid, a feed move, an arc, and a section end each close the chain and set the modal radius. The plunge feed sets `modalR` before the first half-turn, so `chainTip` is the pass tip, not the approach radius.
- The kernel law holds: dips start no earlier than half-turn 3 and end no later than half-turn n-2. The verdict re-reads phase, depth, slope and placement, and a breach is a Gouge. A dip with no cycle record is refused at generation.
- Parameter bytes and project fields are written only when the dips are on. Old files and old digests are unchanged.
- Panic-path scan: every new `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` is in a test file. Provenance lines are present. Clean-room is kept.

**Results.** Local, in `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr468-review`, on the head `5f564c470`. `cargo test -j 6`. All passed:

| Crate | Suite | Passed |
|---|---|---:|
| motion | lib | 401 (6 ignored) |
| motion | turning_thread_dips | 9 |
| motion | turning_thread | 18 |
| motion | turning_thread_cycle | 3 |
| motion | turning_thread_infeed | 10 |
| cl | lib | 45 |
| sim | lib | 185 |
| post | lib | 64 |
| post | recorded_streams | 12 |
| post | inverted_post | 16 |
| post | script_fanuc_lathe | 18 |
| post | lathe_post_refusals | 11 |
| post | post_engine | 33 |
| app | lathe_post_thread_dips | 7 |
| app | project_roundtrip | 73 |
| app | lathe_post_inch | 6 |

Clippy with `-D warnings`: clean on motion, cl, post, sim (`--all-targets`), and on the app and ui libs. The app and ui counts are below the other review's: this head is older than the main of that review.

**Requested before merge (one item, not a code change).**
1. The trial merge with current `origin/main` (`a8bb30f0c`) conflicts in one file: `crates/post/src/post/js.rs`. Main added the `wcs_rotation` field and its `voices_wcs_rotation` method beside the PR's `continuous_threading` field and method (two hunks). The fix keeps both sides. The same law that applies to `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` in the last refresh applies here. This is AGENTS.md contributor mode: `git merge origin/main`, keep both sides, push, and ask for a re-check.

**Notes (not blocking).**
- On this head alone, the unrelated app test binary `wire_tool` does not compile. Main broke it and fixed it in `018aef2b4`. A merge of current main takes the fix. I built and tested around that one binary.
- The post scripts `engine.rs` and `js.rs` exceed the 400-line target. The PR adds 4 and 17 lines. Not a blocking item.
- Not exercised: the full ui lib suite, the ignored heavy lanes, a run on a controller, and a live machine. The dip posting rests on the two new goldens and the suites above.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
